locations.note: Rosa and Joey trace the deaths of university students haunted by the Deacon, a spirit raised with a ouija board.
Rosa scatters the ashes of her aunt Lauren off the bridge at the start.
A doctor from the hospital where Lauren was a patient for decades calls Rosa to collect letters, which set her on the trail of the Deacon.
Joey makes Rosa take him to the park, where they find the ghost of student Alli Montego.

routes.name: Rosa Blackwell
routes.note: From scattering her aunt's ashes to the ghost in Washington Square Park.
